body: Live-mode accessibility leads: (1) Any auto-updating messages/evidence presented alongside controls needs pause/stop/hide or update-frequency control; avoid ticker-like motion. WCAG 2.2 SC 2.2.2: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/pause-stop-hide.html. (2) Never encode connection/urgency/review state by color alone; pair with text plus icon/shape. SC 1.4.1: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/use-of-color.html. (3) Body text contrast >=4.5:1, large text >=3:1. SC 1.4.3: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html. (4) ARIA alerts are brief/important, do not take focus, should not auto-disappear, and frequent alerts harm visual/cognitive users: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/alert/. Recommendation: routine sync changes use role=status; only stage-stopping faults use role=alert, with one persistent recovery banner.
